title: check skips the form of knowledge on draft, done, dropped and planned items, so a malformed field passes until the sprint starts
goal: bl_check.validate checks the form of an item's knowledge field (ask and refs, lists of non-empty texts) on every item, and only the ref resolution and the stale count stay limited to items todo or doing in an active sprint (knowledge_worked); the knowledge_states docstring holds again; a test plants a malformed knowledge on a draft item and check reports it. Found by the SP-xdzgepun review of BG-53f6xe32.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_base,bl_check;bl=bl_base.Backlog('.');iid=next(i for i,it in sorted(bl.items.items()) if it.get('status')=='draft' and it.get('kind')!='sprint');bl.items[iid]['knowledge']='text';sys.exit(0 if any('knowledge' in x for x in bl_check.validate(bl)) else 1)
